levels.name: First Tap
levels.tip: Tap a belt to turn it. Press Run when the path is ready.

levels.name: Bend
levels.tip: Corners turn packages. Aim them toward the matching dock.

levels.name: Detour
levels.tip: Not every belt is part of the route.

levels.name: Pinned
levels.tip: Belts with a pin are locked in place. Build around them.

levels.name: Convoy
levels.tip: Some sources send several packages. Every one must arrive.

levels.name: Two Colors
levels.tip: Packages only accept a dock of their own color.

levels.name: Crossroads
levels.tip: Crossings let routes pass through each other.

levels.name: Junction
levels.tip: Junctions send packages straight when they can — otherwise to the right.

levels.name: Counter-turn
levels.tip: Long-press a belt to turn it the other way. It still counts as one move.

levels.name: Pair Up
levels.tip: Two routes now. Plan both before you press Run.

levels.name: Interchange
levels.tip: Packages wait their turn at busy tiles. The earliest one goes first.
